V-ADA-01.description: `ARCHITECTURE.md` absent (root or current package) — plan cannot reason about approach without it

V-ADA-02.description: `documentation/decisions/INDEX.md` stale — ≥1 Accepted ADR not recorded in decisions/INDEX.md

V-ADA-03.description: `DESIGN.md` absent in project with UI design scope

V-ADA-04.description: `DESIGN.md` tokens out of sync with recent design decisions involving UI/visual changes

V-ADA-06.description: Monorepo package directory missing `AGENTS.md` — package invisible to agent graph

V-ADA-07.description: Sub-package `AGENTS.md` exists but not indexed in root "Package Agents" section

V-ADA-08.description: ARCHIVE lifecycle gap — superseded ADR row in `documentation/decisions/INDEX.md` not updated to "Superseded" status, OR deprecated `DESIGN.md` token categories silently deleted instead of moved to a `## Deprecated Tokens` section (destroys traceability)

V-ADA-09.description: Owner ruling absent or violated — compound trigger: (a) `documentation/reference/product-principles.md` absent when UI/frontend signals are present, mirroring the V-ADA-03/DESIGN.md existence check exactly and reusing the same V-ADA-04 Frontend Detection Keywords SSOT below (no new keyword list) — OR (b) diff violates an *active* recorded owner ruling in `product-principles.md`. Detection is hybrid: structured surface/keyword metadata captured at ruling-append time narrows which diffs are even considered, but the violation call itself is reviewer judgment, not a mechanical/regex match. x-review quotes the violated ruling verbatim in the finding and cites `R-NNN` when the ruling has an Id

V-INT-01.description: Integration pattern divergence — new code uses different convention than established pattern at same touchpoint (validation library, error class, response helper, auth middleware)

V-INT-02.description: Parallel implementation — code reimplements something that already exists as a codebase utility; creates two ways to do the same thing

V-INT-03.description: Convention drift — new code establishes a new pattern variant that will require future migration

V-INT-04.description: Pattern absent — new code at an integration touchpoint is missing a required convention from the Codebase Conventions catalog

V-API-01.description: API contract drift — diff diverges from plan's `## API Contract` specification

V-API-02.description: Undocumented breaking change — breaking API change not flagged as Breaking in plan

V-ARCH-01.description: Approach violation — diff uses patterns from an approach explicitly rejected in the referenced ADR

V-ARCH-02.description: Rejected pattern detected — diff contains an isolated element from a rejected ADR approach

V-PERF-01.description: Performance anti-pattern detected — diff introduces N+1 query, unindexed sort, sync I/O in hot path, full-table scan, or unbounded pagination for a component listed in the plan's `## Performance Budget` section

V-PERF-02.description: Performance regression risk — diff touches a component listed in the plan's `## Performance Budget` section without addressing the documented threshold

V-CONFIG-01.description: Config key convention drift — new config key or env var does not follow the naming convention documented in the plan's Codebase Conventions section

V-CONFIG-02.description: Config convention absent — new config key or env var introduced without being registered in the project's config convention entry in the Codebase Conventions section

V-ASSET-01.description: Agent-asset drift — `.claude/rules/*.md`, `.claude/skills/**/*.md`, `.claude/agents/**/*.md`, `AGENTS.md`, or `CLAUDE.md` contains a file path or symbol name that does not resolve on disk

V-ASSET-02.description: Accepted ADR references a file path that does not exist on disk

V-ASSET-03.description: Plan touches public concepts (classes, modules, CLI verbs, config keys, external services) without `## Agent-Asset Ripple` section identifying affected agent-asset files

V-BRANCH-01.description: Force-push to protected branch (main, master, develop, release/*)

V-BRANCH-02.description: Commit directly to main/master without explicit approval

V-BRANCH-03.description: Branch name does not match `feature-branch.N` convention

V-BRANCH-04.description: Stale local branch — merged or upstream gone

V-WORKTREE-01.description: Worktree leak — stale worktree not cleaned after batch operation

V-WORKTREE-02.description: Missing worktree-state.json persistence during worktree session

V-WORKTREE-03.description: Worktree retains branch checkout lock after its PR reached mergeable state (CI green + `ai-review:LGTM` + no conflict) — see `mercure-worktree-hygiene.md` § Release on PR-Mergeable

V-GIT-02.description: Failed to return to base branch after merge

V-FIX-01.description: Fix applied without documented root cause analysis

V-CHOICE-01.description: Non-trivial change without documented alternative consideration

V-SCOPE-02.description: Plan-task mismatch — implementation focus diverges from the plan's current active task

V-SCOPE-03.description: Missing blast-radius — plan with 3+ affected consumers has no Dependency Blast-Radius section

V-EXT-01.description: File-level extension event without declaration — PR modifies existing SKILL.md with a new `##` section, `argument-hint:` value, V-code reference, or `allowed-tools:` entry, but PR description lacks `## Extension Tax Declaration`

V-EXT-02.description: Step-level accretion — a numbered step in SKILL.md exceeds 80 LOC, grows >50% in a single PR, or contains 4+ distinct conceptual gate patterns

V-CHAIN-01.description: User-invocable workflow skill missing `## After Completion` section — every skill with `user-invocable: true` and `model:` frontmatter must end with an `## After Completion` section containing `AskUserQuestion` routing options. Exemptions: x-help (informational), 12 redirect stubs (no model: field), user-invocable: false skills

V-DOC-02.description: API docs don't match code signatures

V-DOC-04.description: Stale documentation — content contradicts current code, **or** a doc under `documentation/` no longer describes the structure it indexes (superseded chain unresolved, INDEX row pointing at a moved/split file, folder reorganized without its index following)

V-DOC-05.description: Rationale duplicated across sites — same explanation restated at >1 location instead of one canonical site plus references

V-DOC-06.description: Incident archaeology in code comment — issue/PR number, "previously X", or change narration embedded in source

V-DOC-07.description: Comment lines exceed 40% of added lines in the diff (advisory — never blocks)

V-DELEG-01.description: Delegation contract incomplete — `subagent_type` call missing ≥1 of: output format, scope boundary, stop condition

V-DELEG-02.description: Agent()/Workflow agent() call omits explicit model: — silently inherits session model instead of the declared cheapest-capable tier

V-DELEG-03.description: Workflow call site without a declared Agent fallback — skill owns a Workflow script or trigger callout but no `> **Agent fallback:**` callout naming the Agent path (ADR-113)

V-DOC-GOV-01.description: New doc created under `documentation/` without search-before-write check — duplicates an existing concern's canonical doc

V-DOC-GOV-02.description: Doc under `documentation/` missing lifecycle frontmatter (no `type:` or `status:` field)

V-DOC-GOV-03.description: Doc filename includes a date stamp (e.g. `-2026-05-11.md`), violating canonical-path convention (date belongs in frontmatter)

V-DOC-GOV-04.description: Doc replaced with substantially different content but old version lacks `status: deprecated` OR new version lacks `supersedes:` link

V-SOLID-01.description: SRP violation — class/module with multiple reasons to change

V-SOLID-02.description: OCP violation — modification instead of extension

V-SOLID-03.description: LSP violation — subtype breaks parent contract

V-SOLID-04.description: ISP violation — fat interface forcing unnecessary implementations

V-SOLID-05.description: DIP violation — high-level module depends on low-level details

V-KISS-01.description: Unnecessary complexity where simpler solution exists

V-KISS-03.description: Boilerplate scaffolding with no business logic (anti-slop)

V-YAGNI-01.description: Feature built for hypothetical future need

V-PAT-03.description: Missing error handling pattern (bare catch, swallowed errors)

V-PARETO-03.description: Scope creep — implementing beyond stated requirements

V-SEC-01.description: Injection — unsanitized input in SQL/NoSQL/OS commands

V-SEC-02.description: Auth/authz bypass — missing or broken access control

V-SEC-03.description: Hardcoded secrets — API keys, passwords, tokens in source

V-SEC-04.description: Cross-site scripting — unsanitized output in HTML context

V-SEC-05.description: Security misconfiguration — missing headers, unsafe eval, insecure defaults

V-SEC-06.description: Exploitability gate — security finding reported without a concrete, demonstrated attack scenario (who/what/result); theoretical or defense-in-depth-only items

V-SEC-07.description: Adversarial validation gap — security finding reported as confirmed without an independent pass that tried to disprove it

V-THREAT-01.description: Missing threat model — plan for security-sensitive feature has no STRIDE analysis

V-THREAT-02.description: Unmitigated threat — STRIDE analysis identified a threat with no documented mitigation

V-THREAT-03.description: Threat model incomplete — not all six STRIDE categories analyzed

V-TEST-02.description: Production code written before failing test (TDD violation)

V-TEST-03.description: Test coverage below project threshold on changed files

V-TEST-04.description: Disabled or skipped tests without documented justification

V-TEST-05.description: Missing edge case tests for boundary conditions

V-TEST-06.description: Test assertions too weak (truthy checks instead of specific)

V-TEST-07.description: Completion claimed without running tests (evidence violation)

V-TEST-09.description: Coverage regression on changed files — line/function coverage dropped vs. pre-change baseline

V-UX-01.description: Information overload / no progressive disclosure — UI surfaces flat field dumps or fully-expanded views instead of tiered at-a-glance/summary/detail/raw disclosure

V-UX-01a.description: Flat field dump — all fields rendered with equal visual weight, no primary metric (sub-classification of V-UX-01)

V-UX-01b.description: No summarization above ~7 facts/columns — list/table exceeds ~7 visible fields without grouping or drill-down (sub-classification of V-UX-01)

V-UX-01c.description: Everything expanded by default — accordions/sections/trees fully open on load (sub-classification of V-UX-01)

V-UX-01d.description: Buried primary info — headline fact not the most visually prominent element (sub-classification of V-UX-01)

V-UX-01e.description: Deprecated data at equal prominence — stale/historical data same visual weight as current (sub-classification of V-UX-01)

V-UX-02.description: Horizontal-scrollbar overflow at a declared display target — `document.documentElement.scrollWidth > document.documentElement.clientWidth` measured live at a `DESIGN.md` `display_targets` viewport during `/x-review`'s Visual Evidence gate

V-UX-03.description: Visual Evidence section missing from the review report, or present without its required unavailability statement when no runnable stack exists — the "never silently skip" reporting requirement

V-UX-04.description: Accessibility baseline violation — mechanical Lighthouse accessibility category at captured routes: landmarks, heading outline, accessible name, keyboard-focusable controls, WCAG AA contrast; static hunt/analyze path (Grep+Read, no browser) covers the same landmark/heading/name subset on page-level documents

V-UX-04a.description: Colour-only meaning — state, status, or category conveyed by colour alone; hybrid Lighthouse `use-of-color` plus screenshot judgment (sub-classification of V-UX-04)

V-UX-05.description: Misleading data encoding — length-based bar/area without a zero baseline; magnitude shown without unit, period, or population; inconsistent precision within a column — reviewer judgment

V-UX-06.description: Theme parity failure — content illegible, invisible or contrast-failing at the non-default colour scheme (fires only when DESIGN.md themes lists both light and dark)

V-UX-07.description: Motion discipline — animation gates reading, or non-trivial motion lacks prefers-reduced-motion accommodation

V-UX-08.description: Visual anti-slop — chrome added without meaning: nested cards, borders repairing hierarchy that spacing should carry, decorative gradients or glass, metric-box grid substituted for a composed relationship
